title: Weak solutions of the generalized Monge-Ampère equation and the supercritical deformed Hermitian-Yang-Mills equation: boundary cases
summary: We prove the existence and uniqueness of weak solutions for the generalized Monge-Ampère equation and the supercritical deformed Hermitian-Yang-Mills equation in cohomology classes lying on the boundary of the solvable region. Moreover, we prove that the associated geometric flows converge to the weak solutions in the sense of currents. The proof combines viscosity-theoretic and pluripotential-theoretic techniques.
